result.title: FleetPilot: Fine-Grained Steering Empowers Real-World LLM Personalization
result.summary: With the rapid evolution of large language models (LLMs), there is an increasing demand for effective personalization techniques that can adapt model behavior to individual user preferences. Personalized LLMs must infer a user's query-dependent preferences from limited, heterogeneous, and evolving interaction histories. Existing approaches rely primarily on in-context personalization, parametric adaptation, or personalized reward modeling, but respectively incur recurring costs in context management, model optimization and deployment, or multi-candidate generation and scoring. These limitations become particularly restrictive when user observations are sparse and the preference evidence relevant to each query varies across contexts and over time. To address these challenges, we propose \modelname, a fine-grained and instance-tailored steering framework that dynamically generates sample-level interference vectors from user data and injects them into the model's forward pass for personalized adaptation. Our approach introduces: match contrast that produces user-relevant signals, fine-grained steering component that captures nuanced signals by hooking activations from attention and MLP layers, and query-conditioned aggregation module that synthesizes these signals into contextually relevant enhancements. Extensive experiments across diverse scenarios, including short-to-long text generation, and web function calling, validate the effectiveness and compatibility of \modelname. Results show that our method consistently brings significant performance gains, and show extreme superiority in fast-shifting and data-sparse environments. Additionally, \modelname rids us of training cycles and incurs light overhead of storage or inference latency. These make \modelname a strong and real-world deployable method. Implementation is available \footnote{https://anonymous.4open.science/r/FleetPilot}.

AI.brief_summary: FleetPilot 提出细粒度、按样本定制的 steering 框架：从用户数据动态生成干扰向量并注入前向传播，借助 match contrast、hook attention 与 MLP 激活的 steering 组件及 query-conditioned 聚合实现个性化，在短到长文本生成与 web function calling 上验证有效性，且无需训练周期。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「按样本动态生成激活干预向量、hook 多层激活并按 query 条件聚合」的做法，可能与 LVR 中推理期注入与组合 latent 状态、免训练地调控内部表示的方式相通，可供核查；但论文面向用户个性化而非多模态视觉推理，与视觉证据保留和推理决策无直接联系。
